P.name: Searing Brilliance
P.title: Template:Data Mel/Searing Brilliance
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Searing Brilliance|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Mel
|skill        = I
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Mel Searing Brilliance.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mel's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' for each instance of damage they deal to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on {{tt|subsequent damage instances|From her attacks/abilities}} and stacking infinitely.
|description2 = {{sbc|Overwhelm:}} Store {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50;60;70;80|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the affected enemy with the first stack, reduced{{ft|to 50%|to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50*0.5;60*0.5;70*0.5;80*0.5|0 to 3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.5}}% AP)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}. For each stack, store an additional {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|2;3;4;5|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the target. If the total {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} stored exceeds the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} and {{tip|shields}}, the next stack applied against them will consume them all to deal the stored damage.
|description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Searing Brilliance:}} '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate 3 stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals {{as|{{pplevel|8 to 30}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, for a total possible damage of {{as|{{pplevel|8*9 to 30*9}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*9}}% AP)}} at maximum stacks.
|damagetype   = Magic
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spelleffects = proc
|spellshield  = false
|projectile   = true
|parry        = unknown
|notes        = 
* Effects that inherit properties from the origin basic attack (e.g {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}) will also be able to apply ''Overwhelm'' stacks.
** Effects that apply {{tip|on-hit|on-hits}} (e.g {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}) will not apply stacks.
* The first stack also benefits from the per-stack bonus stored damage.
* A threshold indicator for the currently stored damage is placed on a target's [[health bar]], as well as a mark above their head, while any ''Overwhelm'' stacks are active. These are visible to '''Mel''' and her target(s).
** Whenever {{ais|Golden Eclipse|Mel}} damage would put them below ''Overwhelm's'' threshold, the mark will darken and glow more prominently.
*** This does not take into account effects that would amplify the damage such as {{ri|Coup de Grace}}.
* Just before ''Overwhelm'' stacks are consumed, targets have 5 additional stacks applied to them.{{bug}}
** These stacks are consumed immediately.
* ''Overwhelm'' stacks will '''not''' be consumed against {{cai|Undying Rage|Tryndamere}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurbicon    = Mel Searing Brilliance.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate - Overwhelm:}} {{cis|Mel}} damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' to enemies hit for a few seconds, stacking infinitely. Each stack stores {{as|magic damage}}; if the total stored damage would kill the target, the next stack will consume them all to detonate the damage.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate stacks for a few seconds, up to a cap. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks to additionally fire an equal number of bolts dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
}}

W.title: Template:Data Mel/Rebuttal
W.wikitext: {{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Rebuttal|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Mel |skill = W |icon = Mel Rebuttal.png |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' forms a protective barrier around herself for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for the duration, and gaining {{as|{{sti|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Additionally, all hostile {{tip|projectiles}} sourced from enemy {{tip|champions}} that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before '''Mel''' fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the {{tt|original sources|See notes}}, or {{tt|toward herself|See notes}}. |leveling = {{st|Shield|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}} |description2 = Replicated projectiles have the {{tt|same features|See notes}} that the original ones do, but they retain a ratio of the damage that the original ones would deal. Additionally, all of their damage is converted to {{as|magic damage}}, with {{as|physical damage}} instances being reduced to 70% before conversion. |leveling2 = {{st|Replicated Projectile Magic Damage Modifier|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage|Replicated Projectile Physical Damage Modifier|{{ap|40*.7 to 60*.7}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|5*.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage}} |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 175 |cast time = none |cost = {{ap|80 to 0}} |costtype = Mana |cooldown = {{ap|38 to 26}} |targeting = Auto |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spelleffects = special |spellshield = special |projectile = special |notes = * ''Rebuttal's'' barrier will also instantly destroy missiles that are already within its radius when the ability is cast. * The replicated missile will mimic all of the original missile's properties, which includes its range, width, speed, acceleration, angle (if a cone), height, and sight radius. ** Spell effects, as well as interactions with {{tip|spell shield}} and {{tip|projectile|projectile-interception}} effects, all vary based on the original missile that was replicated. ** The only exception to this is the copied missile's path, or trajectory, which is based on the [[targeting|targeting paradigm]] that the original missile used when fired by its source. The replicated missile acquires the original missile source as the target. *** If the original missile was fired by a {{tip|unit-targeted|unit}} or {{tip|auto-targeted}} effect, the replicated missile will be fired as a homing missile with the target being the original missile source. **** Healing projectiles, such as {{cai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}} and {{cai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}, will instead target '''Mel'''. *** If the original missile was fired via any other targeting paradigm, the replicated missile will by default fire in the direction of the original missile source at the time of replication. This includes {{tip|vector-targeted}} projectiles (currently only {{cai|Hextech Ray|Viktor}}), for which the origin will always be '''Mel's''' center (since she cannot control the cast point). * The replicated missile will mimic all of the functions of and copy the behavior of the original missile, unless otherwise stated. This includes every aspect and effect of the missile conforming to the attack or spell from which the missile originated. ** The scaling of the effects of the copied missile is calculated using the original missile source's attributes (namely their [[champion statistic|stats]]). The damage of the missile only benefits from '''Mel's''' [[damage modifier]]s and [[magic penetration]], and not the original source's. * The following missiles are destroyed, but not replicated: ** {{cai|Whirling Death|Draven}} on its way back to him. ** {{cai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}} on its way back to him. ** {{cai|Test of Spirit|Illaoi}} ** {{cai|Boomerang Blade|Sivir}} on its way back to her. ** {{cai|Hijack|Sylas}} ** {{cai|Fear Beyond Death 2|Urgot|Mercy}} ** {{cai|Bladecaller|Xayah}} and {{ai|Featherstorm|Xayah}} ** {{cai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}} ** Missiles fired from [[auto-targeted]] abilities that target each unit in an area and aren't targeting '''Mel'''. *** Examples include {{cai|R|Brand}}, {{cai|R|Katarina}}, {{cai|R|Samira}}, and {{cai|E|Ryze}}. * The following abilities will be stopped short of their trajectory without replication: ** {{cai|Emperor's Divide|Azir}} ** {{cai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Spheres}} thrown with her {{ai|Scatter the Weak|Syndra}} * '''Mel''' may occasionally fail to attribute {{iis|Echoes of Helia}} {{nies|Soul Siphon}} damage projectile to herself.{{bug}} ** This can cause the enemy to be able to kill their own allies, and gain all the kill's [[Kill#Rewards|rewards]]. * ''Rebuttal'' will play distinct sound cues from destroying and replicating projectiles fired from specific types of abilities: ** Non-ultimate ability missile: [[File:Mel_Original_SFX_WReflect_Normal_buffactivate.ogg]] ** Ultimate ability missile: [[File:Mel_Original_SFX_WReflect_Ult_buffactivate.ogg]] ** Ability with global or near-global range missile: [[File:Mel_Original_SFX_WReflect_Global_buffactivate.ogg]] |blurbicon = Mel Rebuttal.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Mel}} briefly conjures a personal barrier with a {{tip|shield}} and a burst of {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' move speed}}}}. |blurb2 = All hostile {{tip|projectiles}} from enemy champions that hit the barrier will rebound as her own projectile, retaining all the same features and converting to {{as|magic damage}}. }}
